briefdescription.para: Wave D — Vector Search High-Cardinality Stress Tests.

detaileddescription.para: Stress tests for the ThemisDB vector search subsystem under high-cardinality workloads. Exercises large-scale insertions, concurrent HNSW build+query, and multiple dimensionality configurations.
All tests use in-process stubs — no external dependencies beyond GTest and the standard library.
